title: DashPass
director: Steve Ayson, Produced for Radke Productions Company
description:
Period dramas have experienced something of a cultural resurgence in recent years. There’s ‘Bridgerton’, ‘The Crown’, and ‘The Gilded Age’ – just to name a few of the major hits to have enticed a devoted following since entering the cultural zeitgeist.
In addition to their pearl-clutching performances, stunning costuming and iconic set pieces, period dramas are known for storylines with heightened emotion, impossible choices, and prolonged yearning. Joining the dots between this emotional vocabulary and the everyday predicament of whether or not to order takeaway, DoorDash Canada and Wieden+Kennedy Toronto unlocked a universal consumer truth.
